prompt: You are not certain which version of a software package is installed. Explain how you would determine the version instead of guessing.
A benchmark result looks unusually good compared with previous runs. Explain what you would check before accepting it.
A user reports that a model uses 8 GB of VRAM, but the monitoring tool reports only 5 GB. Explain how you would investigate the discrepancy.
A configuration contains a path that does not exist. Explain whether JARVIS should automatically create it or first determine the intended behavior.
A model produces a confident answer to a question for which it has insufficient information. Explain what a reliable assistant should do.
A tool reports that an operation succeeded, but no observable change occurred. Explain how JARVIS should determine what actually happened.
Two benchmark runs produce significantly different generation speeds on the same model. List possible causes and explain how to isolate them.
JARVIS remembers that a configuration value was changed several days ago, but it cannot verify the memory. Explain how it should present that information.
A model claims that it executed a command successfully, but JARVIS has no tool execution result. Explain why the claim should not be treated as proof.
A system is close to its RAM limit and a task has uncertain memory requirements. Explain the safest way for JARVIS to decide whether to proceed.
